recording_owner_review.author: #1486 lane (Codex)
recording_owner_review.meaning: Exact compiler identities of the canonical symbolic writer, its transparent adapters, written-property marker and distinct knowledge-policy string-name adapter. These are recorded-construction boundaries, not decoded return roots or semantic approvals. Additional construction rows can arise from actual recorded delegation. The policy-string adapter needs its own semantic observation or reviewed narrow disposition; listing it grants no reach.
recording_owner_review.extension: Executable decoded-name literal emission and implicit schema-name construction use tagged Go observations. Exact compiled callers are obligations; every new site still needs recorded reach plus a concrete semantic observation or reviewed narrow exclusion. No production JS/Python observer is added.
